allow: PowerShell($paths = @\("$env:LOCALAPPDATA\\Microsoft\\WinGet\\Links\\ffmpeg.exe", "C:\\ffmpeg\\bin\\ffmpeg.exe", "$env:ProgramFiles\\ffmpeg\\bin\\ffmpeg.exe"\); foreach \($p in $paths\) { if \(Test-Path $p\) { $p } }; try { \(Get-Command winget -ErrorAction Stop\).Source } catch { "no winget" })
